body:
- **Default to answering, not acting.** Questions / observations /
  "what if" ideations are discussion — not imperatives. Wait for an
  explicit verb ("add", "ship", "fix") before mutating files. Each
  new topic in a session needs its own green light; earlier
  "yes, go" doesn't carry over. (See `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` global rule
  and `memory/feedback_ask_before_acting.md`.)
- **Don't include Claude/AI/Anthropic in commit messages**, no
  Co-Authored-By lines.
- **Never commit / push without explicit "commit" / "push"**, each
  time.
- **Tailwind pkg sources must be `@source`'d** from the host — was a
  real footgun earlier this session (all hover/resize/border
  utilities silently missing from CSS until diagnosed).
- **MV3 CSP is load-bearing** for many architectural choices — don't
  reach for eval, don't suggest MDX JSX, don't suggest inline script
  tags in dev.

---
